summary.tpReason: The underlying AuditLogsHunting telemetry independently confirms four successful application credential-management updates by VadimJ across four distinct enterprise applications. The multi-application scope and mixed browser/Azure CLI execution are materially more consistent with deliberate persistence than a detection parsing error; authorization cannot be established from available telemetry.
summary.fpReason: A legitimate administrator or automation owner could have performed the changes, and the audit records contain no source IP or authorization/ticket context. No direct evidence of credential use or downstream access was found in the queried sign-in data.
summary.whatHappened: At the alert time, 2026-08-19 18:01:05 UTC, VadimJ@buildseccxpninja.onmicrosoft.com was reported adding four credentials to EntApp01, EntApp02, EntApp03, and EntApp04. AuditLogsHunting confirms successful “Update application – Certificates and secrets management” operations: EntApp01 received key PurviewAppAccess (ID 1714a3cf-c8dc-40e6-bc2a-fdfaf55baf42) via Edge/Chrome, while EntApp02 (Key 3, ID 8c123b9d-31e6-4f50-a21f-88eabc8857e5), EntApp03 (Secret, ID bd3aa4f4-0737-42be-8506-1d2378a2ff0b), and EntApp04 (Secret, ID a9d6190a-ee00-45ba-9975-4fa0b00bd4f4) were modified via Azure CLI Python SDK. Source IP was blank.
keyEvidence: AuditLogsHunting shows four successful certificate/secret-management updates initiated by VadimJ, one for each alert target.
EntApp01 key PurviewAppAccess was added through a browser user agent; EntApp02–04 were modified through Azure CLI Python SDK, indicating both interactive and programmatic activity.
The four target application IDs are a05db9f5-91e6-4bba-860e-cf38984e89fc, a9929be8-b429-4918-ab41-0604fc9356b4, 20bdf178-f471-41bd-936f-2d4e0970b66c, and b89ea4f7-3fb2-4731-b1cf-a4ee5d5624b9.
All four audit results are explicitly “success”; this is confirmed modification of application credentials, even though subsequent credential use is not proven.
The Sentinel SecurityAlert record at 2026-08-19 18:01:05.057Z reports the same four applications and keys and is severity High.
researchDone: Queried AuditLogsHunting for credential/key operations and VadimJ activity; found exactly four successful matching updates.
